q2_gaps: attributive comparative with an elided standard ("the older rituals") — the instruction set states there is no licensed form for it and prescribes dropping the comparative, so which rituals are taught is silently widened to the whole definite group
notes: Dropping "older" is exactly what the comparative section prescribes, so the loss is a registered representational gap rather than a parse defect. "Old Vesh" correctly takes the capitalized-modifier name rule (one symbol, one Name, no `old` atom), and the habitual clause correctly gets a bare kind Recipient plus a definite group Theme and no status atom.
